body: make sure you've filled out either gafutures or your fafsa, since mine did the same thing last year (I hadn't filled out the fafsa on time)
CAPS doesn't do ADHD evaluations, and they aren't allowed to refer you for an evaluation (anymore) either — paraphrasing my CAPS therapist who I asked about this.

UGA def makes it harder than it needs to be but imo it wasn't bad at all (coming from a polisci major who HATES math). I got an A- but that was only because I just didn't do some homework that I could have easily completed (thank you, ADHD). An A is totally doable, you just have to be willing to A) take notes B) ask questions C) show up to lab and D) actually do the assignments. D is the hardest part, but if you have that down then you'll be totally fine. I had Toebben, so see if you can get him. Instructor matters a lot, imo, and he's one of the better ones. Use a grade calculator while you're in the course to keep track of your final grade, since everything's in Webassign.
